key_highlights: ASX sheds $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressure equities; miners and banks lead the decline
Iron ore enters a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil explodes as OPEC+ suppression fails, raising input-cost inflation risk
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating any near-term rate-cut path
ANZ.AX completes 3,500-job cut but strategic plan execution remains a long runway
Housing prices crash with first-home buyer surge; auction market shows no spring bounce
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress across junior miners
Australian business confidence deteriorating; fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners lead the $90bn sell-off. Junior miners scrambling for capital via cap raises. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Junior miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) show relative strength but cap-raise dilution risk is elevated. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack safe-haven bid.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure bank valuations. ANZ.AX post-restructuring still faces execution risk. NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from yield curve inversion risk.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin outlook uncertain if RBA holds rates due to rental inflation. Credit growth may slow with housing correction. ANZ.AX 3,500-job cut signals structural cost pressure across sector.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Oil surge benefits producers but raises input costs. Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as a national sacrifice.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from relaxed gas export rules. Oil price spike raises fuel-cost inflation risk for consumers. LNG exporters face geopolitical premium.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) price-freeze credibility questioned. Fuel prices rising 30c. Business confidence weak. Housing correction may boost first-home buyer demand but overall consumer squeeze persists.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CWP.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Defensive consumer staples may see rotation but growth limited. Housing correction supports first-home buyer segment.

sectors.trend: Neutral. CSL.AX and healthcare names relatively insulated. ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) show momentum. Global AI/tech themes (Cloudflare, Ciena) provide sentiment support but limited ASX direct exposure.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive rotation. Small-cap tech/biotech (NEU.AX, ION.AX) attract speculative flows. Limited large-cap ASX tech exposure limits sector impact.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crashing, auction market flat. Rental inflation keeps RBA cautious, supporting REIT occupancy but pressuring valuations via higher discount rates.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face yield compression risk if rates stay elevated. Housing correction may eventually support rental demand but near-term sentiment is weak.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and oil-driven inflation re-acceleration dominate ASX sentiment
Iron ore structural demand concerns (China) trigger commodity 'bloodletting'
AUD weakness amplifies import-cost inflation, complicating RBA policy
Housing market correction accelerates; first-home buyer surge offsets some demand loss
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises signal liquidity crunch in juniors
Superannuation reform debate intensifies; populism vs. fiscal sustainability tension
Australian business confidence at multi-year lows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price surge driving input-cost inflation and RBA policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over importers; monitor RBA commentary on pass-through

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price decline compressing ASX 200 mining earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold or critical-minerals names; monitor China stimulus signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness amplifying imported inflation and equity outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Consider AUD-hedged international exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into credit and construction sectors
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL trends; reduce exposure to construction/property developers; favour defensive REITs with long leases

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap-raise dilution and liquidity stress in junior sector
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid dilutive cap raises; favour well-funded explorers; monitor Canaccord-led raises for sector-wide stress signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical risk (Arctic shipping, G20 tensions) disrupting supply chains
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify supply-chain exposure; monitor LNG and iron ore shipping routes

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy producers on oil surge and relaxed gas rules
opportunities.rationale: Oil price spike plus softened gas export rules create tailwind for WDS.AX and STO.AX; fuel-price pass-through supports margins

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into critical minerals and battery tech on structural demand
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources battery tech validates; Kuniko and Gateway WA gold-silver systems show exploration upside; less correlated to iron ore cycle

opportunities.recommendation: Selective ASX small-cap tech/biotech on momentum
opportunities.rationale: Iondrive, Neurizon, Australasian showing relative strength; global AI theme (Cloudflare, Ciena) supports sentiment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; China demand concerns structural; $90bn ASX sell-off led by miners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash or short-duration bonds; hedge AUD weakness
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-rise fears and AUD smash create volatility; bond yields rising but equity risk/reward poor near-term

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid dilutive junior mining cap raises; favour well-funded names
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led cap-raise wave signals sector liquidity stress; dilution risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hold defensive healthcare and consumer staples for rotation
defensive_moves.rationale: CSL.AX, SGH.AX insulated from commodity cycle; WES.AX/CWP.AX benefit from housing-driven first-home buyer activity

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears and rate uncertainty persist. Iron ore weakness and AUD depreciation create headwinds. RBA rental-inflation concern limits rate-cut catalyst. Expect 3-5% further downside in ^AXJO over 1-3 months unless oil stabilises.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise within 6-12 months, supporting first-home buyer demand. Critical minerals and energy transition themes offer structural upside. Superannuation reform debate could create policy tailwind for listed funds. Iron ore may find floor if China stimulus materialises.
